partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Affected disease-associated gene baseline
results.hypothesis: A chemical that affects a gene associated with a disease may treat that disease.
results.body: chemical -affects-> gene -gene_associated_with_condition-> disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Connects a chemical to a disease-linked gene, but does not require a therapeutically corrective direction or corroborating mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: A two-edge TRAPI query can express the graph pattern; edge-property refinements would require constraints.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[:AFFECTS]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Direct target with disease-gene association baseline
results.hypothesis: A chemical that directly physically interacts with a disease-associated gene may treat the disease.
results.body: chemical -directly_physically_interacts_with-> gene -gene_associated_with_condition-> disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Direct molecular interaction is stronger than generic affects, but the rule lacks direction, functional consequence, and pathway corroboration.
results.trapi_notes: The two-edge path is directly expressible in TRAPI.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Selective inhibition of a causal disease gene
results.hypothesis: A chemical may treat a disease when it selectively decreases the activity or abundance of a gene asserted to cause the disease.
results.body: chemical -affects[causes, activity_or_abundance, decreased]-> causal gene -causes-> disease; chemical qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule links directional perturbation to a causal disease gene, but the graph does not establish whether decreased gene activity corrects or reproduces the disease mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The path and edge qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; the chemical degree constraint requires Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:Gene)-[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Multi-gene inhibition within a disease-supported process
results.hypothesis: A selective chemical may treat a disease when it decreases multiple disease-associated genes participating in the same bounded-size biological process.
results.body: disease has 3-20 associated genes in a process; chemical decreases activity_or_abundance of >=2 of those genes; chemical qualified gene degree <=100
results.mechanism_rationale: Requires coherent multi-gene perturbation and suppresses hubs, but the graph does not establish whether decreasing those genes is corrective.
results.trapi_notes: The graph motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality and degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (object:Disease)-[support:MINER_DISEASE_PROCESS_SUPPORT]->(process)
WHERE support.gene_count >= 3 AND support.gene_count <= 20
MATCH (targeted_gene:Gene)-[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object)
MATCH (targeted_gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(targeted_gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 100
WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT targeted_gene) AS targeted_disease_genes
WHERE targeted_disease_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Normalized phenotype indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A treatment for one disease may transfer to another disease when at least half of the smaller disease phenotype profile is shared and both profiles are bounded.
results.body: chemical -treats-> anchor disease; anchor and candidate disease share >=3 phenotypes; shared/min(phenotype degrees) >=0.5; each phenotype degree 3-50
results.mechanism_rationale: Phenotypic similarity supports indication transfer but does not identify the drug mechanism responsible for efficacy.
results.trapi_notes: The graph pattern is TRAPI-expressible; normalized overlap, degree limits, and source exclusion require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN [$validation_source, $blind_source]
)
  AND anchor._miner_phenotype_degree >= 3
  AND anchor._miner_phenotype_degree <= 50
MATCH (anchor)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object:Disease)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND object._miner_phenotype_degree >= 3
  AND object._miner_phenotype_degree <= 50
WITH subject, anchor, object,
     count(DISTINCT phenotype) AS shared_phenotypes,
     anchor._miner_phenotype_degree AS anchor_phenotypes,
     object._miner_phenotype_degree AS object_phenotypes
WHERE shared_phenotypes >= 3
  AND toFloat(shared_phenotypes) /
      CASE
        WHEN anchor_phenotypes < object_phenotypes
        THEN anchor_phenotypes
        ELSE object_phenotypes
      END >= 0.5
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Normalized genetic indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A treatment for one disease may transfer to another disease when the diseases share multiple associated genes and at least half of the smaller gene profile.
results.body: chemical -treats-> anchor disease; anchor and candidate disease share >=2 associated genes; shared/min(gene degrees) >=0.5; each gene degree 2-100
results.mechanism_rationale: Genetic similarity provides a disease-mechanism bridge, but efficacy is still transferred from an existing indication.
results.trapi_notes: The graph pattern is TRAPI-expressible; normalized overlap, degree limits, and source exclusion require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN [$validation_source, $blind_source]
)
  AND anchor._miner_gene_association_degree >= 2
  AND anchor._miner_gene_association_degree <= 100
MATCH (anchor)<-[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]-(gene:Gene)
      -[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object:Disease)
WHERE object <> anchor
  AND object._miner_gene_association_degree >= 2
  AND object._miner_gene_association_degree <= 100
WITH subject, anchor, object,
     count(DISTINCT gene) AS shared_genes,
     anchor._miner_gene_association_degree AS anchor_genes,
     object._miner_gene_association_degree AS object_genes
WHERE shared_genes >= 2
  AND toFloat(shared_genes) /
      CASE
        WHEN anchor_genes < object_genes THEN anchor_genes ELSE object_genes
      END >= 0.5
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.hypothesis: A chemical tested in clinical trials for a disease is enriched for exact treats assertions.
results.body: chemical -in_clinical_trials_for-> disease

results.name: Direct binding plus inhibition of a causal gene
results.hypothesis: A chemical may treat a disease when it both directly binds and decreases the activity or abundance of a causal disease gene.
results.body: chemical -directly_physically_interacts_with-> causal gene -causes-> disease; same chemical -affects[causes, activity_or_abundance, decreased]-> same gene; qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: Requires target engagement, directional perturbation, and a causal disease link on the same gene, but lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The parallel-edge motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; the degree constraint requires Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Specific drug binding and inhibition without adverse evidence
results.hypothesis: Precision improves when the direct-binding and inhibition rule is restricted to drugs, specific MONDO diseases, and pairs without explicit adverse relations.
results.body: drug binds and decreases causal gene; qualified gene degree <=50; MONDO disease with 1-500 descendants; no has_side_effect, contraindicated_in, exacerbates_condition, or causes edge from drug to disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Retains the same target-level evidence while excluding broad disease hubs and explicit adverse relations, but causal direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse graph patterns are TRAPI-expressible; degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R017 plus affects primary source infores:signor

results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse patterns are TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Low-fanout process-corroborated mechanism
results.hypothesis: Combining causal-target specificity with same-gene disease-process corroboration may remove both literature hubs and isolated causal assertions.

results.mechanism_rationale: Uses two independent biological branches around the same directly engaged gene without treatment evidence, but therapeutic direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The source graph motif is TRAPI-expressible; process-support cardinality, degree, and absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.

      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (object)-[support:MINER_DISEASE_PROCESS_SUPPORT]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(gene)

results.name: Independent clinical low-fanout mechanism
results.hypothesis: A specific causal-target mechanism plus an independently sourced clinical-trial assertion should retain validation hits while excluding disease-gene hubs and target-source leakage.
results.body: R022 plus causal gene disease degree <=12 and clinical-trial source infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines specific target-level evidence with independent translational evidence, but still uses treatment-oriented evidence and lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive motif and provenance are partly TRAPI-expressible; causal-gene degree and adverse-edge absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND COUNT { (gene)-[:CAUSES]->(:Disease) } <= 12
  AND 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials' IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])

  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500

  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Independent clinical disease-relative rescue
results.hypothesis: Disease-relative literature relevance can extend the independent clinical rule to strong pleiotropic targets without restoring general hub noise.
results.body: R022 with independent clinical source plus causal fanout <=12 OR causal publications >=3, causal publication NPMI >=0.5, and within-disease relevance rank <=3
results.mechanism_rationale: Combines disease-relative target evidence with independent clinical evidence, but remains treatment-oriented and lacks disease-mechanism direction.
results.trapi_notes: The biological and clinical motifs are TRAPI-expressible; NPMI, disease-relative rank, provenance, degree, and absence constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject)-[trial:IN_CLINICAL_TRIALS_FOR]->(object)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 3
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
    )
  )
  AND 'infores:multiomics-clinicaltrials' IN coalesce(trial.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Tight multi-gene inhibition in a compact disease process
results.hypothesis: Precision improves when a selective chemical decreases at least three disease-associated genes in a compact process.
results.body: disease has 3-10 associated genes in a process; chemical decreases activity_or_abundance of >=3; chemical qualified gene degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: This is a stricter, hub-resistant multi-target pathway perturbation, but the graph does not establish that decreasing the genes is corrective.
results.trapi_notes: The graph motif and qualifiers are TRAPI-expressible; cardinality and degree constraints require Cypher or post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (object:Disease)-[support:MINER_DISEASE_PROCESS_SUPPORT]->(process)
WHERE support.gene_count >= 3 AND support.gene_count <= 10
MATCH (targeted_gene:Gene)-[:GENE_ASSOCIATED_WITH_CONDITION]->(object)
MATCH (targeted_gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (subject:ChemicalEntity)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(targeted_gene)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT targeted_gene) AS targeted_disease_genes
WHERE targeted_disease_genes >= 3
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
